summary: Ansible 9.11.0 deprecated the unmaintained ngine_io.exoscale collection (removal from Ansible 11) and announced sensu.sensu_go removal from Ansible 12 due to sanity test failures.
questions: Is ngine_io.exoscale still included in Ansible 11?
Why is sensu.sensu_go being removed from Ansible?
How do I keep using sensu.sensu_go after removal?

answer_card.title: ngine_io.exoscale and sensu.sensu_go removals
answer_card.answer_md:
- **ngine_io.exoscale**: deprecated, removed from **Ansible 11** unless a maintainer steps up.
- **sensu.sensu_go**: removed from **Ansible 12** due to unresolved sanity test failures.

Install separately with `ansible-galaxy collection install <name>` if you still need them.
